title: Intel Domain Record — host, IP, ASN, or DNS-infrastructure asset discovered in scope. Dedup key: identity + kind. Prefer intel-dns-record for raw RR data.

identity.description: The primary identifier: FQDN for subdomains/domains/MX/NS, dotted-quad or CIDR for IPs, 'AS12345' for ASNs, rDNS name for PTR.

kind.description: Asset class — drives dedup (identity + kind is unique per engagement): 'subdomain'=enumerated host under an apex; 'domain'=apex domain; 'ip'=standalone IP or CIDR; 'asn'=autonomous system; 'nameserver'=NS host; 'mx'=mail exchanger; 'ptr'=reverse-DNS entry.

value.description: Resolved or supporting value (e.g., A record IP for a subdomain, ASN range for an IP, MX target hostname).

source_name.description: Tool or data source that discovered this asset (e.g., 'subfinder', 'asnmap', 'shodan', 'cero', 'ct-logs').

notes.description: Context: WAF detected, CDN vs origin, interesting response headers, cloud provider, takeover candidate, etc.

agent_name.description: Specialist agent role that recorded this row (e.g., 'recon-specialist').

artifact_ref.description: vigil artifact ID or path that contains the raw evidence.

captured_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when this row was written.

command_run_id.description: Command-run audit row that produced this intel.

code_snapshot.description: Immutable source snapshot behind code-derived intel.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim tool output line that supports this record.
